No message appears next to the field and the negative value stays in the field.
reproSteps: Open https://5503-izxouzvjflo86mc67ty9v.e2b.app/eval/harbor-handbook/issues/1 and scroll to the Time Tracker section in the right sidebar
Click the "Time Tracker" heading to open its menu and choose "Add Time"

findings.name: A long line in a fenced code block is cut off and makes the issue page scroll sideways

findings.expected: The comment should keep the page at the viewport width: a long code line should either wrap or scroll inside the code block, the rest of the line must stay reachable, and the issue page should not gain a horizontal scrollbar.
findings.actual: The long code line is clipped at the edge of the comment box with the rest of it unreachable, and the whole issue page becomes 1706px wide on a 1280px viewport (426px of horizontal scrolling). The same measurement on issue #4 (no long code line) returns 1280/1280, so the overflow comes from the rendered comment content.
reproSteps: Go to /eval/harbor-handbook/issues/new

Title: agent12-longtext wrap test. In the comment box paste: a line of ~130 'A' characters, then a fenced code block whose single line is: <?php echo "a very long code line that should scroll inside its block rather than stretch the page AAAA...A"; ?> (about 180 characters) followed by a small markdown table and 'مرحبا بالعالم 🚀 José'
Click Create Issue (opens /eval/harbor-handbook/issues/29)

Look at the rendered comment: the text inside the grey code block stops at the right edge of the comment box mid-word (no ellipsis, no scrollbar inside the block), while the normal paragraph above it wraps correctly
Compare the page width with any other issue (e.g. /eval/harbor-handbook/issues/4): the document of #29 is 1706px wide while the viewport is 1280px, so the page scrolls horizontally into empty space

findings.actual: Fuzzy and Exact return the same empty set: "checklis" gives "No results" in both modes, and "onboard" also gives no results in Exact and in Fuzzy, although issue #1 (\"Expand the onboarding checklist\") and its body contain those words. Only the complete word ("onboarding") finds it (1 result, 1 Open). So choosing Fuzzy never changes the outcome — a near-miss word returns nothing.
reproSteps: Sign in as eval (momentic-eval-1) and open https://5503-izxouzvjflo86mc67ty9v.e2b.app/issues.

The Participants avatars and the timeline's \"alex\" links on the same page correctly go to /alex, and the sidebar milestone entry correctly goes to /eval/harbor-handbook/milestone/1. (on /eval/harbor-handbook/issues/1)
findings.expected: Clicking the assigned user in the issue sidebar should open that user's profile (/alex), like the avatar of the same user in the Participants block and in the assignment timeline entry.

reproSteps: Sign in as eval / momentic-eval-1 and open https://5503-izxouzvjflo86mc67ty9v.e2b.app/eval/harbor-handbook/issues/1 (an issue with an assignee).
In the right sidebar, find the Assignees block showing the user "alex" with their avatar.
Click the avatar or the name "alex".

The same happens on issue #4 (assignee alex): clicking the sidebar assignee gives .../issues/4# and no profile page.
